changes_made.explanation: No major changes needed. All extracted metadata is correct and relevant to NLG tasks. The paper clearly addresses text obfuscation/generation tasks.
Normalized 'ME-TEOR' to 'METEOR' as it appears to be a typo. The paper uses METEOR to evaluate semantic preservation of obfuscated texts.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The evaluation is based on authorship attribution accuracy and METEOR scores.
No human evaluations are conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automatic (attribution accuracy and METEOR scores).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on authorship attribution and text obfuscation/deobfuscation. While it involves text generation (obfuscation), the primary evaluation metric is authorship attribution accuracy rather than traditional NLG quality metrics. The extracted metadata was generally accurate with only minor normalization needed for METEOR metric.
